inputs: Resolve inherited default, parameterized, and varargs constructor calls, field constants, array copies, and aliases.
Collect finite named keys from constructor declarations plus execution-reachable store reads and helper calls; unresolved dynamic reads are tracked separately.
Required groups are asserted only with resolved keyRequired arrays and reachable organizeKeys/checkOptional execution. A comma-separated alias group requires one alias.
Pure positional calls need values through the highest enforced required index. Named calls satisfy each enforced group; additional execution validation remains an audit gap.
Omission of the whole parameter argument is an independent proof. Source-base contracts default to requiring an explicit argument even when their individual fields remain optional/unverified.
outputs: Trace execute returns, returned NounMetadata locals/assignments, and self/super helpers. Explicit ERROR nouns are outside the expected-success contract, matching runPixel manual generics.
NounMetadata actual Java value types establish scalar/map/collection/array shapes; PixelOperationType never establishes object fields.

PixelStreamUtility special cases explicitly establish FRAME, STORAGE, TASK/REMOVE_TASK, CODE/TASK_LIST, and VECTOR output wrappers. Other special serialization paths stay unknown unless manually audited.
Java reference nulls remain possible at top level; frame/storage optional fields reflect Gson null omission. Double/Float outputs allow null for non-finite values.
Nested map/list schemas remain unknown and tracked. Empty arrays are valid; empty/opaque noun returns do not imply a fictitious success output.
AdditionalOutput and delayed/error results retain existing transport semantics; these are expected-success output hints, not runtime validation or a guarantee of one successful response.

parameterOmission.rule: Source-derived optional fields do not prove no-argument execution. Every base contract explicitly requires the parameter argument unless a source-specific zero-input audit proves omission. This does not assert that all individual required fields have been verified. Audited contracts use their manually verified parameter forms.

prerna.reactor.UUIDReactor.reason: execute only creates a GUID v7 string; it never reads a noun store, curRow, keyValue, inherited input helper, or supplied parameter.
